tools.name: list_requirements
tools.description: What the label law of a country asks a product's label to carry, before a label exists: the mandatory items, the items needed only in some cases, the language rule and what to check by eye, each with its law and the official sources.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_label" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
